serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Pharmacy was broken into it seems…
There is a hole in the window and boxes with pills and other medicine are laying on the ground…
Staff already started to sort things out.
Pharmacist: We are closed today.
Well, that’s a given I guess…
You: When will you be open? I have something to buy.
Pharmacist: I don’t know. Does it seem like we are going to be open anytime soon?
You: N-no?
Pharmacist: Now go away! You are disturbing us.
That was pretty rude, but I would probably be the same if I had to clean up all this mess.
People that need prescription drugs to survive are in a very bad situation, I hope it gets all sorted out fast.
